abilities.descEn: Has a high chance of creating a powerful shield that can't be broken for 5 seconds when Rangers deploy. Prevents attack and instant kill effects while the shield is up.\n\n- The defense effects of said Ability only apply to Rangers' Skills and Ability attacks.
abilities.descZh: 出動時能以高機率在5秒內形成無法被解除的強力防護罩。防護罩形成中可抵擋攻擊和立即消滅的效果。\n\n※該能力的防禦效果對象僅限於Ranger的技能和能力攻擊。

abilities.descEn: Rangers with this Ability won't be affected by charm effects.
abilities.descZh: 持有這個能力的Ranger不會受到誘惑效果影響。

abilities.descEn: Sometimes 1 additional Ranger is produced at no extra cost.
abilities.descZh: 以一定機率只消耗生產1隻Ranger所需的礦物量就生產出2隻Ranger。

abilities.descEn: One of that Ranger's skills will activate when they are defeated.
abilities.descZh: Ranger被打倒時將發動一項自己的技能。
